questions.question: The plan already includes a shell check that pC.txt exists and contains exactly `x`. What kind of tests do you want added?

options.label: Keep shell check
options.description: Keep the one-line shell check as the test and approve the plan as it stands.

options.label: Test script file
options.description: Add a small script, such as test_pC.sh, to the repo that checks pC.txt, and run it.

options.label: Test framework
options.description: Add a test in the project's test framework. I'd first look for how tests are set up here.
